weights.derived: random initialization on each forward pass; connection structure derived from hidden_nodes positions

R: Three fixed red input nodes (x₁, x₂, x₃) on the left of the canvas
Two fixed blue output nodes (y₁, y₂) on the right of the canvas
User-placed yellow hidden nodes in the central region
Directed arrows connecting all layers; animate green (input→hidden) then orange (hidden→output) during a forward pass
Activation values displayed on each node after a forward pass
An output activation progress bar and percentage readout at the bottom
A 'Send Signal' button and a 'Clear' button
T: Clicking in the central canvas zone places a new hidden neuron and immediately triggers an animated forward pass
Pressing 'Send Signal' replays the forward pass with newly randomized weights
Pressing 'Clear' removes all hidden nodes and resets the output bar to 50%
srtc.C: Adding more hidden neurons generally introduces more non-linearity. The output activation always falls in (0, 1) due to the sigmoid function, regardless of network topology.
